The '''Aramand system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was centered around the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Aramand]] and contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The system was also part of the [[Aramand Cluster]].
